newsitem.title: UK: Global LPG continues to soar on low stocks, cold.
newsitem.headline: Global LPG continues to soar on low stocks, cold.

text.p: Worldwide prices for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) continued their relentless surge this week, with U.S. demand still leading the way.

A combination of strong demand in the U.S. and East Asia, low inventories in the US, cold weather in Europe and the realisation that the northern hemisphere winter is just beginning have all helped push prices ever higher.
In NWE, propane traded on Thursday at $343 a tonne for 10,000 tonnes CIF France and this was immediately followed on Friday by a trade at $349.50 cif France for 10,000 tonnes.
